name: Release Notes Pipeline
description: On demand (optionally on a cadence), turn merged PRs and commits since the last release into user-facing release notes in this project's voice, gated by an editor SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict where every claim traces to a merged PR or commit, then optionally DRAFT a GitHub release / announcement (drafts only, never auto-published). All project specifics (voice, what to include/exclude, audience, release source) come from this project's pack under .glissa/teams/release-notes/pack/.

stages.summary: Collects merged PRs / commits since the last release from this repo and writes brief.md (the changelog inputs), every entry traceable to a PR number or commit sha.
Drafts ONE user-facing release-notes document in the project's voice from the brief; every claim traces to a PR/commit in the brief. Writes notes.md.

Audits the release notes for voice, avoid-list, no emoji/dashes, and makes 'every claim traces to a PR/commit in the brief' its top checklist item; writes review.md ending in VERDICT: SHIP | FIX | BLOCK.
On a SHIP verdict, DRAFTS a GitHub release body + an announcement post into published.md (copy-paste payload only; never creates/publishes a release). Writes published.md.
